label: Structured shared-IO feature process - production59 primitive-consistent causal rollout - layer 8 orthogonal derivative-of-Gaussian knot-basis function approximator P256 V256 K<=2 - statistical symmetric Gram whitening - K1 2x1s input x 59 - K2 2x1s primitive output x 17 rederived to 59 - balanced 50% return / 25% other derived / 25% direct primitive MSE - minute primitives boundary-masked - W256 - M128 - P128 - F128 - PF256 - NF256 - 256k clean - batch 10240 train and evaluation - no regularization - weight EMA 4 epochs

layer8FunctionApproximator.causality: output step s uses the query point at s and only knots/values from generated NF states <=s

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number is one exact shared module reused at every matching block; layers other than 8 remain GNGLUs, while layer 8 is one shared causal orthogonal knot-basis function unit
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; shared layer 8 maps the causal generated NF-state prefix through normalized query points, normalized key knots, derivative-of-Gaussian basis values, explicit statistical Gram whitening, and knot values to emit expected W; shared layer 2 decodes W only to 17 primitive causal coordinates; differentiable fixed code reconstructs the complete future production59 state
architecture.baseConsistency: BTC one-second candle geometry, return activity, aggregate trade flow, aggressor side, spot volume, completed futures-minute state, and ETH minute return are decoded once; every affected production channel is derived from the same predicted primitive history
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

loss.description: 50% standardized two-step return MSE, 25% standardized MSE over the other 58 derived production channels, and 25% standardized direct primitive-coordinate MSE; the three minute-cadence primitive coordinates are supervised only when that output step completes a minute

sampling.description: the exact original production59 dense chronological nonzero-target population
sampling.comparisonControl: identical sample origins, K1/K2, latent widths, Q/K/V/output widths, balanced objective, optimizer, examples, batches, and EMA as the balanced attention predecessor; only the layer-8 attention weighting is replaced by the orthogonal derivative-of-Gaussian knot basis

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.comparableMetrics: step-1 and per-step return metrics remain directly comparable to the balanced self-attention predecessor

alignment.input: the same two consecutive production59 timeline rows ending at each control example origin
alignment.target: the same two complete chronological production59 rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.causalDerivation: only predicted primitive coordinates and observed history through the input origin enter changing future channels; predicted step 1 updates rolling state before step 2; no observed future derived feature is consumed
alignment.primitiveSupervision: all per-second primitive coordinates are directly standardized and supervised; futures-minute and ETH-minute primitive coordinates receive direct loss only at their causal completion boundary; the hourly volume feature has no separate future primitive and remains derived from the causally accumulated per-second spot-volume coordinate
alignment.functionBasisCausality: the step-s point is evaluated only against knots and values from generated NF states at steps <=s; Gram statistics are estimated independently for each causal prefix and never include padded examples
